description: Use this when the user wants to view or search for teams. IMPORTANT: Use this tool to find team IDs by searching team names, which can then be used to filter projects. Supports text search and pagination.

includeFormer.description: Also list the teams the user left that still hold their own time entries, after the current ones. They are read-only for the user.

limit.description: Maximum number of teams to return. Defaults to 20 if not specified.

manageable.description: The teams the user may create projects, tags and rates in: the ones they manage plus every team of the organizations they administer

managed.description: Only the teams the user manages (team manager or owner)

memberUserId.description: Only the teams this user is an active member of

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based). Use with limit to fetch subsequent pages.

search.description: Search query to filter teams by name (partial match supported)

sort.description: Sort field: alpha=alphabetical by name, permission=by user permission level, created=by creation date

name: team_list

teams.description: List of teams matching the criteria

title: List Teams
